prediction_time: On trading date t, after the opening price is available and before the market close for that ticker.
assumptions: One record per publisher ticker and trading date. A ticker is an identifier and is not assumed to identify the same company across decades.
Prior sessions are earlier valid observations for the same ticker. Calendar gaps may reflect holidays, suspensions, missing data or quarantined records.
Price adjustment policy, currency and exchange coverage must be verified before interpreting historical errors across tickers or using features in point-in-time deployment.

columns.name: ticker
columns.definition: Ticker symbol as provided by the source.

columns.name: close
columns.definition: Daily closing price as provided, used as the label.

columns.name: volume
columns.definition: Total daily trading volume as provided.

columns.name: dividends
columns.definition: Publisher dividend amount on that date, retained for EDA.

columns.name: stock_splits
columns.definition: Publisher stock split ratio. Zero indicates no split in the feed.

features.name: open_price
features.available_at: Once date t's opening price is known
features.justification: Measures the price level at prediction time and provides the baseline.

features.name: previous_close
features.definition: Closing price from the previous accepted row for that ticker.
features.available_at: After the previous valid session closes
features.justification: Captures the recent price level using earlier labels only.

features.name: mean_close_previous_5
features.definition: Mean of the five strictly earlier accepted closing prices, null without all five.
features.available_at: After the previous valid session closes

features.name: previous_range_fraction
features.definition: Previous valid session's (High minus Low) divided by its Close.
features.available_at: After the previous valid session closes
features.justification: Approximates recent volatility relative to price level.

features.name: log_previous_volume
features.definition: Natural log of one plus previous valid session's volume.
features.available_at: After the previous valid session closes
features.justification: Compresses the scale of prior trading activity.
